html:
Searching for dependable, transparent car rental in Chennai? At SR Tours & Travels, we provide well-maintained, chauffeur-driven AC cars, SUVs, luxury vans, and tempo travellers for local city travel, airport transfers, corporate commutes, wedding transportation, and outstation holidays across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Kerala.

Why Choose SR Tours for Car Rental in Chennai?

  • Wide AC Fleet: Choose from Swift Dzire, Toyota Etios, Toyota Innova (6+1 & 7+1), Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross, Toyota Corolla Altis, Toyota Fortuner, Kia Carnival, Tempo Travellers (12–18 seater), and Mini Buses.
  • Transparent Tariff: Flexible 4 Hrs / 40 Km and 8 Hrs / 80 Km local packages plus affordable per-km outstation pricing with zero hidden fees. View our full Car Rental Tariff.
  • 24/7 Doorstep Pickup Across Chennai: Instant pickup from Madipakkam, Pallikaranai, Medavakkam, Chrompet, Tambaram, Pallavaram, Nanganallur, Perungalathur, Vandalur, Velachery, OMR, and Chennai Airport (MAA).
  • Experienced, Verified Drivers: Courteous, route-expert chauffeurs trained for highway safety and temple/hill-station driving.

Popular Car Rental Services in Chennai

  • Local Hourly Car Rental: Shopping, business meetings, hospital visits, and Chennai city sightseeing.
  • Chennai Airport Pickup & Drop: Punctual 24/7 flight-tracked airport cabs from Pallikaranai, Madipakkam, Tambaram, and all Chennai localities.
  • Outstation Car Rental from Chennai: One-day and multi-day trips to Tirupati, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Rameswaram, Ooty, Kodaikanal, and Munnar.

Book Your Car Rental in Chennai Today

Call or WhatsApp +91 9884300373 / 9884050506 or send an enquiry online. Visit our office at No. 1389, Mylai Balaji Nagar, 3rd Block, 1st Main Road, Madipakkam, Pallikaranai, Chennai - 600100.
